lines.t: Thus says The Lord: Say no more, “Grace versus The Law.” Say rather, “Grace AND The Law.” For Grace is the fulfillment of The Law. And where there is an absence of grace, there is lawlessness.

Therefore, keeping The Law is a reflection of My own spirit in you. For anyone who says, “I am in The Lord and He is in Me,” while forsaking The Law, is a liar, and will be found as such in the Day of Reckoning. For I AM WHO I AM, the same and unchanging, nor do I stand divided against Myself. Yet My children do continually use My name and that gift given them as a sword by which they attempt to justify their sins, which I hate! Desecration!
Thus until the Day be fulfilled,
Let those who do wickedly continue therein,
Let those who do wickedly continue therein,
And let those who seek righteousness walk therein,
But oh how blessed are those who have
Received of Grace, and seek to please The Father
By obeying His Law, and teach men so...
